wiki.title: Tim Bearden
wiki.extract: Timothy J. Bearden is an American politician. He is a member of the Georgia State Senate from the 30th district, serving since 2024 after winning a special election to replace previous senator Mike Dugan. He previously served in the Georgia House of Representatives from the 68th district, serving from 2005 to 2011. He is a member of the Republican Party. Bearden was also appointed director of the Georgia Public Safety Training Center by former governor Nathan Deal in 2011.
